crossRefs.note: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh…
Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “Yahweh says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of…
he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room: and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama…
When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son…
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…
The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land…

people.name: Azzur
people.line: Father of the false prophet Hananiah.

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: A false prophet who opposed Jeremiah's prophecies.

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in Yahweh’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
translations.bsb: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, near the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the LORD in the presence of the priests and all the people:
translations.kjv: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
translations.asv: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of Jehovah, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
